fieldLogs.title: A second seam
fieldLogs.text: Survey note: the bright return marks a second shallow seam beside the entry shaft. One good haul repairs a machine. Two good hauls change what it can do.

fieldLogs.title: The missing survey
fieldLogs.text: The survey mast recorded a hollow knock before its signal failed. This rock has rooms inside it. Keep the shaft open and mark a way home before following an echo.

fieldLogs.title: A borrowed ceiling
fieldLogs.text: The crew braced the gallery with broken hull plates. Dust falling from a shelf is a warning, not decoration. Wait for the fall from a safe place.

fieldLogs.title: Pressure valve
fieldLogs.text: The lander's valve was carried down for emergency storage. Whoever left it here expected the lander to fly again. The serial number still matches your repair list.

fieldLogs.title: The fused layer
fieldLogs.text: Heat welded the old debris into two continuous layers. The stock cutter cannot bite it. A reinforced drill can open the way, slowly; there is no gap around the edge.

fieldLogs.title: Antenna workshop
fieldLogs.text: An improvised antenna points into solid rock. A note on its mount reads: the signal is below us, not above. Take the antenna back before searching deeper.

fieldLogs.title: The surveyor's compass
fieldLogs.text: A polished core keeps turning toward the oldest cavity. The first surveyor called it a compass, although it never pointed north. Its housing belongs in a collection, not a furnace.

fieldLogs.title: Warm lock
fieldLogs.text: The service locker has frozen shut around a thermal seal. An ice-world auger should release it without damaging the contents. Leave a marker and return with the right tool.
